sources.label: Official Free People UK size guide (tops, product-page modal, United Kingdom and Europe views)

audit: Free People's /help/size-guide pages (US and /en-gb) now 404; the chart is in each product's Size Guide modal, with a country switcher. Uses the tops chart in the United Kingdom view (native cm): bust and natural waist only, no hips for tops, so hips removed. UK/US/EU as published (XS = US 0-2 = UK 4-6 = EU 32-34). Free People's separate dresses/one-pieces chart has hips but different bust at the top end (L 100-104, XL 108 cm), so it is not mixed in. Old entry was one to two UK sizes off (XS = UK 8 vs official UK 4-6) and had no XXS.
